summary: Frontend-only retest of Month MIS frozen columns + footer totals after iteration_21 visual-polish fixes. VERIFIED PASS: no runtime crash on month expand (0 error elements, clean console), table uses table-layout:fixed with explicit width 3290px, all 10 frozen columns (month..disbursed) are position:sticky with correct cumulative left offsets (0,80,190,300,395,480,565,645,730,850) and identical x positions before and after scrolling to max scrollLeft (1644 of 3290 on 1646px viewport) - zero shift, zero bounding-box overlap between adjacent frozen headers, non-frozen columns scroll away (remark th x 1219 -> -425). Header text-bleed is FIXED: overflow:hidden + text-overflow:ellipsis now render 'SANCTION AMOU...' / 'DISBURSED AMO...' clipped inside their 120px cells instead of bleeding. Totals row is complete: TOTAL (8) / amount 'Rs 0' / sanction 'Rs 1,00,00,000' / disbursed 'Rs 50,00,000' - none blank. Select-mode sticky checkbox cells now have opaque backgrounds (tbody rgb(255,255,255), thead rgb(248,250,252)). ONE NEW/REMAINING DEFECT FOUND: the totals-row frozen cells use bg-[#2c587a]/5 = rgba(44,88,122,0.05), i.e. effectively transparent, so once scrolled the non-frozen totals cells (pf 'Rs 0' at x 895-1005, insurance 'Rs 0' at x 1005-1115, tenure at 1115-1225) slide underneath and visibly bleed through the Amount/Sanction/Disbursed totals - the Amount total renders as a doubled/garbled 'Rs 0' and the Sanction total renders as 'Rs 1,00,[blob]0,000'.

ui_bugs.issue: Frozen totals <td>s are painted with bg-[#2c587a]/5 -> computed backgroundColor rgba(44, 88, 122, 0.05), which is ~transparent. After horizontal scroll the scrolled-away non-frozen totals cells (mis-total-Apr-2026-pf x=895..1005 'Rs 0', -insurance x=1005..1115 'Rs 0', -tenure x=1115..1225) sit directly behind the sticky Amount (894-979), Sanction (979-1099) and Disbursed (1099-1219) totals and their text shows through, producing a doubled 'Rs 0' over the Amount total and 'Rs 1,00,[overlap]0,000' over the Sanction total. Fix: give the frozen totals cells an OPAQUE background (e.g. a solid hex like bg-[#eef2f6] / #e9eff4 that matches the 5% tint over white, or inline backgroundColor:'#eef3f7') instead of an alpha tint. Same class is used on the totals-row checkbox td.

Frozen body <td>s are hardcoded bg-white, which overrides the row-level selected highlight (bg-blue-50/60) and hover (hover:bg-slate-50/50) for the 10 frozen columns - a selected row will only show blue in the scrolling area, not in the frozen band. Consider making the frozen cell background follow the row state (e.g. selectedIds.has(loan.id) ? 'bg-[#eff6ff]' : 'bg-white').

With overflow:hidden the frozen headers are now truncated: 'CUSTOMER NA...' (scrollWidth 112 > clientWidth 110), 'SANCTION AMOU...' (122 > 120), 'DISBURSED AMO...' (129 > 120). Functionally fine, but consider +12px on customer_name/sanction/disbursed, or add a title attribute so the full label is discoverable on hover.

issues: Totals row Amount/Sanction values are visually garbled after horizontal scroll due to the transparent sticky background (see HIGH bug above)
Every data row shows an em-dash in Amount, Login Date, Remark etc.; footer Amount total is Rs 0 - correct for seed data but confirm the intent (amount vs sanction fallback)
Action column is sticky right in tbody only; the thead and totals-row action cells are not sticky, so the far-right column edge is inconsistent (cells are empty so it is not visible today)

action_items: HIGH: replace bg-[#2c587a]/5 on the frozen totals-row cells (and the totals checkbox td) with an OPAQUE colour so pf/insurance/tenure totals stop bleeding through the Amount/Sanction/Disbursed totals on horizontal scroll (MonthlyMIS.jsx lines 1341-1352)
LOW: make frozen tbody cell background follow selected/hover row state instead of a hardcoded bg-white
LOW: widen customer_name/sanction/disbursed by ~12px or add title tooltips so truncated headers remain readable
critical_code_review_comments: Sticky/frozen cells must never use an alpha-tinted background - any rgba() with low alpha lets the scrolled content show through. Use solid colours for every sticky cell (thead, tbody AND totals row).

MonthlyMIS.jsx is ~1950 lines; FREEZE_KEYS/COL_WIDTHS/getFreezeStyle/getTableWidth are recreated on every render inside the component. Hoist them to module scope and split the file per the <=700-line guideline.

getFreezeStyle falls back to `|| 80` when accumulating left offsets but `|| DEFAULT_COL_W (110)` when setting width - divergent fallbacks will silently break freeze offsets if a new frozen key is added without a COL_WIDTHS entry. Use one constant.

success_rate.frontend: 5 of 6 requested checks PASS (freeze positioning, no-overlap, table-layout:fixed, all 3 footer totals present, opaque select-mode checkbox column, header text-bleed fixed); 1 FAIL - totals-row frozen cells are transparent and bleed scrolled content

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the remaining bleed-through: Tailwind's slash-opacity class bg-[#2c587a]/5 compiles to rgba(44,88,122,0.05). A position:sticky cell only masks the content scrolling beneath it if its own background is fully opaque; at 5% alpha the underlying <td>s (pf/insurance/tenure totals, which land exactly on top of the Amount/Sanction/Disbursed columns because they are 110px wide against the 85/120/120px frozen columns) remain visible and their text composites over the totals. Repro: login -> Month MIS -> Apr-2026 -> set container scrollLeft to scrollWidth -> inspect totals row. Mitigation: use a solid hex background on all sticky cells (the same pattern already correctly applied to thead bg-slate-50 and tbody bg-white).
